subject: Post-call: SilverLine inference needs — latency & topology next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinson <alex.martinson@silverline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jul 2, 2028 at 3:04 PM PDT
Subject: Post-call: SilverLine inference needs — latency & topology next steps

Alex / Samira — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned. I tried to keep this lean; call notes + concrete asks below.

Key pain points you confirmed:
- User-facing search and recommendation flows are very latency sensitive: target p95 end-to-end is ~120ms for short prompts (under 40 tokens), with peak QPS spikes of ~600 qps during morning syncs.
- Current self-hosted stack struggles with KV cache invalidations and cold-start token latency during bursty traffic.
- Cost predictability is a blocker for procurement — need clear unit economics and a bounded spend during POC.

Goals we heard from your side:
- Bring search/recommendation responses to p95 < 120ms and p99 < 350ms for main flows.
- Validate throughput at 500–700 sustained qps with graceful degradation when saturated.
- Run a 4-week POC on representative production traffic with metrics ingestion into your Datadog.

Technical notes from discussion (high-level):
- Model: you want to evaluate an off-the-shelf 7B instruction-tuned model (open weights) and compare a quantized variant for throughput.
- Topology options: Dedicated pool (reserved GPU capacity) + prefix/KV caching at the edge looks like the best fit; fallback to hosted lightweight model for degraded states.
- Ops integrations: Need audit logs and KMS for keys (you flagged SOC2 + FedRAMP controlled data paths).

Proposed next steps / asks:
1) Marissa will draft an initial topology sketch (Dedicated + cache + fallback) with per-token cost estimates and a capacity plan (target: 500 qps sustained, 700 qps burst). ACTION: Marissa by Wed 7/4.
2) SilverLine to share 24–48h representative traffic sample (anonymized) and current latency histograms. ACTION: Alex / Samira by Tue 7/10.
3) We’ll propose a POC scope (4 weeks) including success criteria and a capped cost estimate. ACTION: Connor by Fri 7/6.
4) Security questionnaire + KMS integration doc we sent earlier — Alex to indicate required controls.

Attachments: silverline-mop.pdf (example mutual action plan we use for POCs); redwood-sla-proposal.xlsx (seed numbers for cost/throughput).

If that aligns, I’ll lock Fri 7/6 for the POC kickoff call once we have the traffic sample. Thanks again — I’ve added tentative calendar times in the drive link below.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0139

----

(Attachment stubs: silverline-mop.pdf [17KB, pdf], redwood-sla-proposal.xlsx [28KB, spreadsheet])

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinson <alex.martinson@silverline.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jul 3, 2028 at 09:18 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Post-call: SilverLine inference needs — latency & topology next steps

Thanks — adding a few technical clarifications and an initial sketch of numbers based on what we heard.

Quick clarifications:
- Baseline measurements: p95 < 120ms target is tight but achievable on a 7B quantized model with prefix caching for repeat queries. That assumes a ~85% cache hit rate on your search prefix patterns; if cache hit drops to 50% we expect p95 to move closer to 200–250ms.
- Throughput: For 500 qps sustained with 40-token prompts, we recommend a dedicated GPU pool sized at ~8 x A10G-equivalent instances with continuous batching (we’ll simulate with your traffic). Burst headroom to 700 qps requires autoscale policy tuned to 3-minute ramps or immediate burst capacity.
- KV cache: recommend a two-tier cache: local per-node KV cache for hot prefixes + global Redis-backed prefix index to stitch misses. This keeps cold-starts bounded.
- Fallback policy: configure a lightweight hosted model (smaller 3B variant) to respond when Dedicated saturation > 90% and degrade gracefully (shorter output length).

What we’ll include in the topology sketch (deliverable):
- Node counts and GPU types for Dedicated pool
- Expected p50/p95/p99 under three cache-hit scenarios (90%, 70%, 50%)
- Cost delta for quantized vs FP16 variants and per-token estimates for your provided sample
- Integration checklist: KMS, audit logs, Datadog metrics forwarding, and SSO config

I’m attaching a quick CSV I used to model latency vs QPS; will convert to slides for Connor’s POC doc.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

(Attachment stubs: latency-model.csv [12KB])

From: Alex Martinson <alex.martinson@silverline.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira.patel@silverline.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jul 4, 2028 at 08:21 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Post-call: SilverLine inference needs — latency & topology next steps

Connor / Marissa — this is great, thanks for the crisp notes. A few comments from our side:

- We’ll export a 48-hour sample of anonymized traffic and the latency histograms by Tue 7/10. I’ll put them in the Drive folder (see link in Connor’s note).
- On cost: procurement needs a hard cap for the POC. Can you provide a worst-case capped number for 4 weeks (assume 700 qps sustained for 24 hours, just to stress test)? We can use that as a procurement ceiling.
- Security: we need to confirm KMS + audit log retention options (minimum 90 days). Also confirm whether Private/VPC deployment is required for us to satisfy certain customers.

We’re 👍 on the POC but need POC scope doc + capped cost estimate to sign off internally. Can you aim to send the POC scope + cost by Fri 7/6?

Thanks — Alex
VP, Engineering | SilverLine Analytics
alex.martinson@silverline.ai | +1 646-555-1188

(Attached: silverline-rfp-attachments.zip [compressed, 2.1MB])

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jul 5, 2028 at 09:12 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Post-call: SilverLine inference needs — latency & topology next steps

Perfect — I’ll get the POC scope + worst-case capped estimate to you by end of day today (Fri 7/6 EST — apologies for timezone math, meant Fri 7/6 PDT).

Internal note to Marissa / Irene: I’ll include the 700 qps stress-case numbers, and two topology options (Dedicated + cache vs Private VPC full deployment) with cost delta and security controls. Once Alex confirms the traffic sample we’ll run our preliminary sim and lock the kickoff date.

Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com

(Internal: calendar hold tentatively set for Tue 7/10 10:00 AM PT for POC kickoff pending sample receipt.)
summary: Post-call recap and technical deep-dive notes capturing SilverLine's latency and throughput targets, proposed Dedicated+cache topology, and next steps to deliver a 4-week POC with capped cost.
